params.message:
Measure models fairly: POEM beyond the earned share, same signals per model, Medium 3.5 and GLM 5.3

The runs of 2026-10-10 ranked models by plain POEM accuracy, but the gold set is
three quarters 'earned' (39,860 of about 53,200 rows): a model that answers
'earned' to everything scores 75%, above three of the four models measured. Each
run also drew its own 50 random rows, so part of every gap between two models was a
gap between two samples. And the judge needs a third family once Model B may
become Mistral.

- eval-metrics.mjs: POEM confusion per type, balanced accuracy (mean recall per
  type), Cohen's kappa, recall and precision per type; stored in model_evals.details
  and printed under each run
- leaderboard: ranked by balanced accuracy, with kappa beside it; runs from before
  it was recorded sort below; optional since date and a signals column
- eval-models: --n, --lang, --seed, --balanced and --since (eval-args.mjs); a
  seeded or balanced draw picks from the ids and then reads only the chosen rows;
  `all` covers every API provider with a key; a bad option prints a message;
  the script loads .env itself, as the supervisor does, so a fresh shell has
  the provider keys
- catalog: Mistral Medium 3.5 (mistral-medium-2604) and Z.ai GLM 5.3
  (zai-glm-5-3, served by Mistral on the EU endpoint), ids as the endpoint listed
  them; first-run results noted next to Small 4 and Large 3
- docs: the defaults table in CLAUDE.md (said Sonnet for classify) now points at
  DEFAULTS; the verify-tier note and the consensus header no longer name DeepSeek
- no phase default changes
